data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the right order (EDGAR ticker search, 10-K filter, Wikipedia infobox, email draft with the same subject and body). However, it hardcodes the recipient as dana@example.com instead of using {manager}@example.com, says "Send or discard" where the true workflow says never send and always Discard, and omits the Wikipedia and Mail tab switches and the click-to-focus details, which makes it less safe and less precise to automate.
